question: Should ClawSegmentedControl automatically wrap every option set larger than four, or should multi-row layout be an explicit caller-level choice for Skill Workshop and similar screens?
rationale: Both shapes fix the demonstrated truncation, but source and tests cannot determine the intended long-term contract for a shared Android design-system component or future callers.

options.title: Add explicit wrap policy
options.body: Preserve the shared one-row default and let Skill Workshop opt into balanced multi-row layout, avoiding an implicit behavior change for future callers.

options.title: Adopt automatic wrapping
options.body: Keep the current patch and document more-than-four as the shared component’s global layout contract, accepting that all future large sets wrap automatically.

recommendation.title: Add explicit wrap policy
recommendation.body: Preserve the shared one-row default and let Skill Workshop opt into balanced multi-row layout, avoiding an implicit behavior change for future callers.

likelyOwner.reason: The Android README identifies @obviyus as the best available owner for the shared design-system decision.
